# QuietCli Git command reference

<!-- Generated by src/Git/scripts/Export-GitCommandReference.ps1. -->

[Git module and examples](../src/Git/src/FrenchExDev2.QuietCli.Git.PoSh/README.md) · [Regenerate or check this page](scripts/Git/Export-GitCommandReference.md)

The companion registers 58 specialized command handlers. The inventory tracks stable Git `>=2.40.0` and `<2.57.0`.

The forms below describe implemented result routes with representative argument patterns. The Git argument schema and installed version govern available options. Use `Get-QuietGitCoverage` to inspect inventory availability and qualification.

Read Outcome, Completeness.Source, Completeness.Analysis and Error before using Data. Also check command-specific fields such as AnswerComplete, Found and OperationOutcome. Fields below describe Data. Command and GitVersion are common where present.

## Command forms

| Native Git form | Result fields or projection | Scope and limits |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `add -- <path>` | [Local ref observation](#local-ref-observation) | Includes native dry-run forms. Staged content and index changes are outside this observation. |
| `annotate -- <path>` | `Lines`, `Scope` | Uses native line-porcelain attribution. |
| `annotate --porcelain -- <path>` | [RequestedFormat](#requested-format) | Explicit display modes retain native records. |
| `blame [<rev>] -- <path>` | `Lines`, `Scope` | Retains line attribution and source text bytes. |
| `blame --porcelain -- <path>` | [RequestedFormat](#requested-format) | Incremental and explicit display forms retain native records. |
| `branch --list [<pattern>]` | `Branches` | Entries include Name, ObjectId, Current and Upstream. |
| `branch --show-current / branch --format=<format>` | [RequestedFormat](#requested-format) | Explicit display form. |
| `branch <name> [<start-point>] / branch -d <name>` | [Local ref observation](#local-ref-observation) | Ref changes are observed locally. |
| `check-attr <attr> -- <path> / check-attr --stdin -z <attr>` | `Kind`, `Entries` | Uses NUL-delimited path, attribute and value triples. Supply explicit input for --stdin. |
| `check-attr --stdin <attr>` | [RequestedFormat](#requested-format) | The newline-delimited input form keeps native output records. |
| `check-ignore -q <path>` | `AnyIgnored`, `ExitCode` | Exit 1 means the predicate is false. |
| `check-ignore --stdin -z / check-ignore -z <path>` | `Kind`, `Entries`, `AnyIgnored`, `ExitCode` | Supply -InputBytes for NUL input. QuietCli adapts literal paths to the NUL stdin form. |
| `check-ignore [-v] <path>` | [RequestedFormat](#requested-format) | The newline display form keeps requested records. |
| `check-mailmap <contact>` | `Contacts` | Native mailmap resolution. |
| `check-ref-format <ref> / check-ref-format --normalize <ref>` | `Valid`, `NormalizedName`, `Values`, `ExitCode` | A valid ref needs no output. NormalizedName is populated when Git writes a name. |
| `checkout <branch> / checkout -- <path>` | [Local ref observation](#local-ref-observation) | Local ref and HEAD observation. Worktree content and index changes are outside this observation. |
| `checkout-index -- <path>` | [Local index observation](#local-index-observation) | Alternate destinations with --temp or --prefix are rejected. File contents are outside the observed scope. |
| `cherry-pick <commit> / cherry-pick --continue` | [Local worktree observation](#local-worktree-observation) | Includes local ref observations when available. |
| `clean -n` | [RequestedFormat](#requested-format) | Dry-run output is returned as requested records. |
| `clean -f` | [Local worktree observation](#local-worktree-observation) | Actual removal is a native operation. Only observed worktree state is reported. |
| `clone <repository> [<directory>]` | `Destination`, `Repository`, `DestinationObserved`, `ExitCode` | Probes an explicit destination. Implicit clone destinations and recursive submodule state are outside the observation. |
| `commit -m <message> / commit -F <file>` | `Before`, `After`, `Changed`, `ExitCode`, `Observation` | Uses HEAD before and after. Supply an explicit message or interaction. |
| `config --list / config list` | `Operation`, `Entries`, `Found`, `ExitCode` | Reads configuration entries. Config values may be sensitive. |
| `config --get <name> / config get <name>` | `Operation`, `Values`, `Found`, `ExitCode` | A lookup exit of 1 means no value. |
| `config --show-origin --list / config --get-regexp <pattern>` | [RequestedFormat](#requested-format) | Alternate display modes retain native records. |
| `config --add <name> <value> / config set <name> <value>` | `Operation`, `OperationOutcome`, `ExitCode`, `Scope` | Reports native write status. Values are omitted from the projection. |
| `count-objects [-v]` | `Counts`, `Alternates`, `SizeUnit` | Uses the verbose numeric protocol in KiB. |
| `count-objects -v -H` | [RequestedFormat](#requested-format) | Human-readable units retain native records. |
| `describe [--tags] [<commit>]` | `Descriptions`, `Scope` | Parses the long form. Abbreviations do not prove full object IDs. |
| `describe --contains / describe --dirty / describe --abbrev=0` | [RequestedFormat](#requested-format) | Custom suffix, contains and short forms use native records. |
| `diff [--cached] [<rev>] [-- <path>]` | `OutputMode`, `Files`, `Commits`, `Preamble`, `Scope` | Patch projection. --exit-code accepts native exit 1; inspect the native exit code. |
| `diff --name-status [-z] / diff --check / diff --stat` | [RequestedFormat](#requested-format) | Explicit formats retain requested records. |
| `diff-files [-- <path>]` | `OutputMode`, `Files`, `Commits`, `ExitCode`, `Scope` | Uses the NUL-framed raw protocol with full IDs. |
| `diff-files -p` | `OutputMode`, `Files`, `Commits`, `Preamble`, `Scope` | Patch projection. |
| `diff-files --name-status [-z]` | [RequestedFormat](#requested-format) | Explicit formats retain requested records. |
| `diff-index --cached <tree> [-- <path>]` | `OutputMode`, `Files`, `Commits`, `ExitCode`, `Scope` | Uses the NUL-framed raw protocol with full IDs. |
| `diff-index -p <tree>` | `OutputMode`, `Files`, `Commits`, `Preamble`, `Scope` | Patch projection. |
| `diff-index --name-status <tree>` | [RequestedFormat](#requested-format) | Explicit formats retain requested records. |
| `diff-tree -r <tree>` | `OutputMode`, `Files`, `Commits`, `ExitCode`, `Scope` | Uses the NUL-framed raw protocol with full IDs. |
| `diff-tree -p <commit>` | `OutputMode`, `Files`, `Commits`, `Preamble`, `Scope` | Patch projection. |
| `diff-tree --name-status -r <tree>` | [RequestedFormat](#requested-format) | Explicit formats retain requested records. |
| `fetch [<remote>]` | [Local ref observation](#local-ref-observation) | Observes local refs affected by the fetch. The requested native operation may contact a remote. |
| `for-each-ref [<pattern>]` | `References` | Entries include Name, ObjectId, Type and SymbolicTarget. |
| `for-each-ref --format=<format>` | [RequestedFormat](#requested-format) | Custom formatting and quoting are native records. |
| `grep -q <pattern>` | `Mode`, `Matched`, `ExitCode` | The predicate can be false with a successful QuietCli outcome. |
| `grep -l <pattern> / grep -L <pattern>` | `Mode`, `Files`, `HasResults`, `ExitCode` | Structured path results use NUL framing. |
| `grep [-n] <pattern>` | [RequestedFormat](#requested-format) | Native line records. |
| `hash-object <file> / hash-object --stdin` | `Objects`, `Found`, `ExitCode` | Reports object identities. Supply input explicitly for --stdin. -w writes an object. |
| `init [--bare] [<directory>]` | `Destination`, `Repository`, `DestinationObserved`, `ExitCode` | Probes the requested destination or working directory on success. |
| `log [-n <count>] [<rev-range>]` | `OutputMode`, `Commits`, `Scope` | Commits include full object and parent IDs, author, committer, subject and body. Supply a count to bound the walk. |
| `log -p` | `OutputMode`, `Files`, `Commits`, `Preamble`, `Scope` | Patch projection. |
| `log --oneline / log --format=<format>` | [RequestedFormat](#requested-format) | Explicit display forms retain native records. |
| `ls-files [--stage] [-- <path>]` | `Files`, `WithStage`, `PathRepresentation` | Stage mode includes mode, object ID and stage. Path entries preserve native bytes where needed. |
| `ls-files --eol / ls-files --debug` | [RequestedFormat](#requested-format) | Alternate report formats retain native records. |
| `ls-remote [--exit-code] <repository> [<pattern>]` | `References`, `Found`, `ExitCode` | Native remote observation. --exit-code uses 2 for a missing match. |
| `ls-remote --get-url <repository>` | [RequestedFormat](#requested-format) | Returns the requested URL record. |
| `ls-tree [-r] <tree> [-- <path>]` | `Entries`, `Scope` | Projects mode, type, object ID, size and path through NUL framing. |
| `ls-tree --format=<format> <tree>` | [RequestedFormat](#requested-format) | Explicit formats retain requested records. |
| `merge <commit> / merge --abort` | [Local worktree observation](#local-worktree-observation) | Conflicts and local ref changes reflect observed state. |
| `merge-base [--all] <left> <right>` | `Objects`, `WithParents`, `Found`, `ExitCode` | Exit 1 can indicate no common ancestor. |
| `merge-base --is-ancestor <left> <right>` | `IsAncestor`, `ExitCode`, `Scope` | Native ancestry predicate. Exit 1 means false. |
| `mv <source> <destination>` | [Local worktree observation](#local-worktree-observation) | Content and hook effects are outside the observation. |
| `name-rev <rev> / name-rev --all` | `Names` | Native labels can be undefined. Labels are separate from object IDs. |
| `name-rev --name-only <rev>` | [RequestedFormat](#requested-format) | Custom display and stdin modes retain native records. |
| `pull [<remote> [<refspec>]]` | [Local ref observation](#local-ref-observation) | Only local HEAD and refs are observed. Native integration and network behavior depend on the requested Git call. |
| `push [--dry-run] <remote> <refspec>` | `Remote`, `References`, `ExitCode` | Uses Git porcelain over Pipe. Reference acceptance is reported by Git. |
| `read-tree <tree>` | [Local index observation](#local-index-observation) | --index-output is rejected. Updates to worktree contents are outside the observed scope. |
| `rebase <upstream> / rebase --abort` | [Local worktree observation](#local-worktree-observation) | Interactive forms require explicit interaction or input. |
| `rebase --show-current-patch` | [RequestedFormat](#requested-format) | Returns the requested patch records. |
| `reflog [show] [<ref>]` | `Entries`, `Scope` | Uses the requested native reflog walk. Old IDs are outside the projection. |
| `reflog exists <ref>` | `Operation`, `Exists`, `ExitCode` | Exit 1 means the reflog does not exist. |
| `reflog show --format=<format>` | [RequestedFormat](#requested-format) | Explicit formats and non-show/exists operations retain native records. |
| `remote [-v]` | `Remotes` | Returns configured fetch/push URLs from the local repository. |
| `remote get-url <name> / remote show <name>` | [RequestedFormat](#requested-format) | Preserves native requested records. remote show may query the remote. |
| `remote add <name> <url> / remote remove <name>` | `Subcommand`, `Before`, `After`, `ExitCode`, `Observation` | Observes local remote configuration. |
| `reset --soft <rev> / reset --mixed <rev> / reset --hard <rev>` | [Local worktree observation](#local-worktree-observation) | Local refs and worktree state are observed. Reset can discard changes. |
| `restore [--staged] -- <path>` | [Local worktree observation](#local-worktree-observation) | Reports observed index and worktree state. |
| `rev-list [--parents] <range>` | `Objects`, `WithParents`, `Found`, `ExitCode` | Typed object IDs and optional parents. |
| `rev-list --count <range> / rev-list --objects <range>` | [RequestedFormat](#requested-format) | Counts, objects with paths and explicit display variations retain native records. |
| `rev-parse --verify [--quiet] <rev>` | `Objects`, `WithParents`, `Found`, `ExitCode` | Use --verify for a typed object ID. A quiet miss has Found=false. |
| `rev-parse --show-toplevel / rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree` | `Kind`, `Selector`, `Value`, `ExitCode` | A single supported path, Boolean or format selector uses Pipe. |
| `rev-parse --symbolic-full-name <ref>` | [RequestedFormat](#requested-format) | Other option-bearing forms use requested records. Bare positional input such as rev-parse HEAD currently fails in the handler. |
| `revert --no-edit <commit> / revert --abort` | [Local worktree observation](#local-worktree-observation) | Conflicts and local ref changes reflect observed state. |
| `rm [--cached] -- <path>` | [Local worktree observation](#local-worktree-observation) | Content and hook effects are outside the observation. |
| `shortlog -s [-n] <range>` | `Groups`, `Scope` | Groups preserve native labels and counts. |
| `shortlog <range>` | [RequestedFormat](#requested-format) | Without --summary the output remains native records. |
| `show <rev>` | `OutputMode`, `Files`, `Commits`, `Preamble`, `Scope` | For a non-blob using the default patch format. |
| `show <rev>:<path>` | `ObjectType`, `Expression`, `OutputMode`, `Artifact` | A single object resolved as a blob produces an owned artifact. Release it in the same session. |
| `show --format=<format> <rev>` | [RequestedFormat](#requested-format) | The explicit format route applies when the object is not selected as a blob. |
| `show-ref [--verify <ref>]` | `References`, `Found`, `ExitCode` | Full references and object IDs. A quiet lookup uses the exit code for Found. |
| `show-ref --exists <ref>` | `Exists`, `ExitCode` | Requires a Git version with --exists. Distinguish absent and error by the native code. |
| `show-ref --hash / show-ref --abbrev` | [RequestedFormat](#requested-format) | Explicit short/hash formats retain native records. |
| `stash list` | `Stashes` | Entries contain Reference, ObjectId and Subject. |
| `stash show [<stash>] / stash list --format=<format>` | [RequestedFormat](#requested-format) | Native requested output. |
| `stash push / stash apply [<stash>]` | [Local ref observation](#local-ref-observation) | Observes local refs. Stash-induced file content changes are outside this scope. |
| `status [--short] [-- <path>]` | `Repository`, `Branch`, `HeadOid`, `Counts`, `Entries`, `Operations`, `Profile`, `Digest`, `Diagnostics`, `Scope`, `AnswerComplete` | Uses one structured result across display flags. Pipe required. Bare repositories and non-worktree positions return classified answers. |
| `status --no-ahead-behind / status --no-show-stash` | `Ahead`, `Behind`, `AheadBehindComputed`, `StashCount`, `Scope` | Omitted or unavailable values can be null. Inspect AnswerComplete and repository kind. |
| `switch <branch> / switch -c <branch>` | [Local worktree observation](#local-worktree-observation) | Also observes local ref changes. |
| `symbolic-ref [-q] HEAD` | `Reference`, `Exists`, `Values`, `ExitCode` | A quiet miss is reported with Exists=false. |
| `symbolic-ref <name> <ref> / symbolic-ref --delete <name>` | [Local ref observation](#local-ref-observation) | Local ref and HEAD observation. |
| `tag --list [<pattern>]` | `Tags` | Projects tag name, object ID, type and peeled ID where available. |
| `tag --format=<format> / tag --verify <name>` | [RequestedFormat](#requested-format) | Explicit formatting and verification output retain native records. |
| `tag <name> [<object>] / tag --delete <name>` | [Local ref observation](#local-ref-observation) | Local ref observation. |
| `update-index --add -- <path>` | [Local index observation](#local-index-observation) | Index stat flags and extensions are outside the observed projection. |
| `update-index --show-index-version` | [RequestedFormat](#requested-format) | Returns the native version record. |
| `version [--build-options] / --version` | `Version`, `BuildInformation` | BuildInformation contains the additional native lines when requested. |
| `worktree list` | `Worktrees` | Uses the NUL-framed porcelain listing. |
| `worktree add <path> [<commit>] / worktree remove <path>` | `Subcommand`, `Before`, `After`, `ExitCode`, `Observation` | Compares independent local worktree lists. |
| `write-tree` | `Objects`, `Found`, `ExitCode` | Reports the native tree identity and may create a tree object. |

## Shared result projections

### Requested format

OutputMode is RequestedFormat. Records contains the selected native records as UTF-8 text or an explicit byte representation. Delimiter identifies the record boundary. Pipes are required for byte record projections.

### Local ref observation

HeadBefore, HeadAfter, BranchBefore, BranchAfter, ReferenceChanges, ExitCode, OperationOutcome and Observation. The before/after reads are independent and cover local HEAD and refs.

### Local worktree observation

Before, After, Conflicts, ReferenceChanges, State, ExitCode, OperationOutcome and Observation. Before and After are local HEAD, index and worktree snapshots around one native operation. Ref changes are sampled for switch, reset, merge, rebase, cherry-pick and revert.

### Local index observation

Before and After are active index entries with stage, mode, object ID and path. ExitCode, OperationOutcome and Observation report native execution and snapshot availability. File contents and index flags outside those tuples are outside the projection.
